text: [VAR 1003][VAR 0100(0000)]!\nSeems you’re doing well collecting Gym Badges.[VAR 0114(0004)]

But Hop...\c
Did something happen with him?
He was acting really odd when I ran into him.\c
He took one look at me and immediately was
like, “I’m so sorry, Lee!”\c
It might be the first time I’ve heard him apologize
for anything, and I’ve no idea what it was for![VAR 0114(0004)]
Maybe he’s feeling down because he’s had some\nhard losses in battle?[VAR 0114(0004)]
He lost to that Challenger Bede

When you lose, you feel down in the dumps.\c
But then there’s nowhere left to go but back up!
You’ve got to think on why it was you lost, though.\c
You know, that little brother of mine...I think he
might yet become a surprisingly great Trainer![VAR 0114(0004)]
At least I’ve got you to keep an eye on him.\nYou will look out for Hop, won’t you? As his rival.[VAR 0114(0004)]

Blast, and look at the time!\c
Nearly forgot my meeting with the chairman.
That Oleana really lets me hear it when I’m late!\c
Now if only I could remember which way to go...[VAR 0114(0004)]

Anyway, I’d say that you should go and say hello
to Raihan while you’re here, [VAR 0100(0000)].\c
He’s the greatest rival I’ve got and the final
hurdle you’ll have to face in the Gym Challenge.\c
He should still be around the vault, if you hurry.
It’s down that way—on the way to Route 6.[VAR 0114(0004)]
